title: Course source coverage
description: Which allowlisted pages cover each objective of one course map, how well, and whether the objective is open to authoring. A capture and authoring plan, not evidence: questions cite content/sources records, never this file. The lint checks the objective list against the course map and every URL against the allowlist.

reviewed_at.description: Date the coverage was last checked against the docs index (YYYY-MM-DD).

id.description: domain-N/<objective id>, exactly as in the course map.

status.description: open: authors may write items. held: excluded from author scope until a source exists.

volatile.description: The covering pages carry figures that change (prices, quotas, versions, tables). Items test the logic, not the figure.

existing.description: Id of an already-captured content/sources record for this exact URL.

allOf.description: An open objective needs at least one source; only a held one may have none.
Nothing documents a missing objective, so it cannot be open to authoring.
